title: Datology AI Open Sources Zephon for Deterministic AI Data Loading
summary:
Researchers can now eliminate inconsistent evaluation results in AI training when scaling across different GPU counts. Datology AI has released an open source data loader called Zephon that provides elastic determinism, ensuring that a training run on 16 GPUs yields the same evaluation outcome as one conducted on 8 GPUs.

The tool enables on-the-fly tokenization at scale, which removes the need for users to re-materialize entire datasets every time a pipeline is modified. Datology developed Zephon after finding that current dataloaders failed to reliably support these features and noted that the system has sped up experiment iteration for its internal teams.

At @datologyai we run thousands of data experiments. Two things keep biting us:

- Same run on 16 vs 8 GPUs → different evals
- Every pipeline change → re-materialize the dataset

Introducing Zephon, the data loader we built to process data on the fly, deterministically. 🧵 https://t.co/VxpjbXTcZh
